spec.label: m4max-studio-dd12-95g · burst-limits · 200 hosts · round 1
spec.notes: Traffic limit search, one cell at a time: each of the 100 cells (5 rates x 5 burst intervals x TCP/UDP x clients -> servers / mesh) finds the most hosts at which its traffic still gets through (delivered >= 95%, UDP loss <= 1%) and the fewest at which it doesn't, 50 hosts apart (bench_suite.py runs one size per benchmark with the cells that want it). Clients -> servers: north-south through the routers and the core, one server per 50 clients. Mesh: each host sends to its next two neighbours, east-west inside a LAN. Paced bursts: each flow sends rate x interval bytes at once, every interval. Rested cells: before each cell the host must be quiet (CPU under 10% for three sweeps, up to 20 minutes: a fresh deployment keeps Docker busy for minutes) and then idles a minute, so a fanless laptop starts every cell from a cooled chip instead of heating up through a run of heavy cells.
